decisions.reason: The selected LED part, model, package, and color format are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Selecting the exact SK6812MINI-E component does not itself change the established 5V supply or level-shifter requirements and does not resolve the separate-control uncertainty.
The LED model and package selection does not change the independent standby cutoff behavior, control GPIO, or separate LED power-control architecture.
The LED component selection is unrelated to I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or cable constraints.
The selected LED part does not alter the sensor-board connector inventory, pinouts, module list, or sensor supply.
The LED component selection does not change the specified ESP32-S3 module model or breakout requirement.
Providing an LCSC identifier for the LED does not modify the general component-sourceability or cost-control policies.
The LED model and package selection does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or 3.3V power-path topology.
The switched rail already includes SK6812 LEDs as a powered load, and the exact LED part selection does not change its voltage, loads, GPIO, or control topology.
The LED part selection does not change the standalone USB regulator, its capacity, activation condition, or powered 3.3V rail.
The LED component selection is unrelated to the ESP32 BOOT and reset controls or their capacitance values.
The exact LED model and package do not alter the interboard connector types, pinouts, or board power-distribution topology.
